tagline: Agree on your site's design rules once, then keep them
use_when: The same kind of inconsistency keeps turning up across pages, like three heading sizes or two card styles, and you want one site-wide rule instead of fixing it page by page.
promises: Nothing changes until you approve it
try_it: Use the style-guide skill to audit my whole site for inconsistent headings, spacing, colors and card styles, and propose rules.

features.label: Starts From What's Decided
features.sub: Reads your existing rules first and never re-asks
features.title: Reads your existing rules first and never re-asks
features.what: If your project already has a written style guide, or rules saved from an earlier run, those count as decided. Run it again anytime and it only proposes what is new or still inconsistent, so the guide grows over time.

features.sub: Type, spacing, color and components across every page
features.title: Type, spacing, color and components across every page
features.what: It scans all your pages for headings, body and small-print sizes, spacing on phone and desktop, color use, repeated components like cards and headers, disclaimers and dark mode. Anything already scheduled on your to-do list is left alone.
